messages:
Alice (Sales Eng): quick question — Acme Robotics wants a 6-week POC on Dedicated with a 40% discount and to waive the APAC region surcharge because they'll route traffic through EU. can this be approved without exec sign-off?
Nina (Deal Desk): heads-up — discounts >30% and any surcharge waivers usually need Deal Desk approval + finance review. need the revenue impact and the exact quote id. also cc @Maria. :thinking_face:
Alice (Sales Eng): quote id is Q-88921, estimated spend ~ $48k over the POC period. they’re an early strategic account but not yet in enterprise contract. putting the ask here to save time.
Rajat (Presales): technically ok to route through EU, but dedicated pools have utilization floors; if we slice pricing too deep we lose our cost cover on reserved GPU time. we should prefer a short-term credit or promotional SKU instead of permanently changing ratecard.
Alice (Sales Eng): understood. they specifically asked for "40% off line-rate + surcharge waived" since procurement needs to see that in the quote.
Nina (Deal Desk): please fill the discount request template, include ARR-equivalent and expected gross margin delta. without those we can't rule. also, legal will need to approve any surcharge waiver for APAC routing.
Alice (Sales Eng): dropping the payload here to speed it up:
```json
{
  "customer": "Acme Robotics",
  "engagement": "6-week POC",
  "quote_id": "Q-88921",
  "requested_discount": "40%",
  "waive_apac_surcharge": true,
  "estimated_spend_usd": "48000",
  "sales_owner": "Alice (Sales Eng)"
}
```
Maria (Finance): quick note — we can authorise up to 35% as a promo credit handled via billing (non-contractual) without VP sign-off, provided the effective margin impact is <15%. anything >35% or that changes contractual ratecard needs FP&A + VP Sales sign-off. also need a simple P&L impact line.
Nina (Deal Desk): ok — proposal: offer a 35% line discount + one-time bill credit to get to ~40% effective for the POC. works as temporary workaround and doesn’t touch the published ratecard. can you compute the credit amount and send me the final quote PDF?
Alice (Sales Eng): will compute numbers and attach the quote in ~30m. if Deal Desk thumbs up, i'll push it to procurement. :thumbsup:
Rajat (Presales): also note — if they convert to committed capacity later, we should switch to commit pricing (we can re-evaluate discounts on a longer-term ARR). logging this so we don't accidentally create a precedential special-term.
ratebot: docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/deals/discount-guidelines (promo flows + billing credit pattern)
Nina (Deal Desk): thanks — once you attach the updated quote and the P&L line, i'll route to finance for the 35% promo approval. cc @Maria. last thing: flag any legal clauses about data egress since they requested cross-region routing.
Alice (Sales Eng): will do. pinging here when quote attached.
Maria (Finance): noted — will review as soon as it's in.
Alice (Sales Eng): attaching quote now (Q-88921_v2.pdf) — 35% + one-time credit gives effective 39.8% off line-rate. starting Deal Desk review.
Nina (Deal Desk): received. starting review. if all good i'll mark as approved and send billing instructions. :white_check_mark:
